items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: And it was because these two guys loved what they were doing so much that they put up with almost anything and everything

ctx.x: And it was because these two guys loved what they were doing so much that they put up with almost anything and everything, things that I think were really preposterous, in relation to the effort they were putting into it and the young people they eventually wound up with. Because some time ago, they lost most of the they took more mature players who live in New York and played with them on Monday nights.
